Sri Ganganagar hottest in Rajasthan as temperature hits 40°C:Monsoon to reactivate from September 2; state records 22% rainfall deficit so far
The monsoon's absence continues in Rajasthan. According to weather experts, similar weather is expected to prevail in the state until September 1. Under the influence of a new low-pressure system that has formed over the Bay of Bengal, rainfall activities are likely to begin in the state from September 2.
On Sunday, the sky remained clear and sunny throughout the day. The highest temperature was recorded in Sri Ganganagar, where it reached 40 degrees Celsius. Maximum temperatures above 35 degrees Celsius were also recorded in Pilani (Jhunjhunu), Churu, Phalodi, Bikaner, and Jaisalmer.
On Sunday (30 Aug), several parts of the state experienced sunshine during the day accompanied by light winds. This led to a slight dip in temperatures in several cities, providing relief from the humidity. The maximum temperature remained below 35 degrees Celsius in Barmer, Ajmer, Jaipur, Udaipur, Kota, and Jodhpur.
Big monsoon updates...
Low-pressure system forms in the Bay of Bengal
Weather experts said that a low-pressure system has formed over the Bay of Bengal off the coasts of West Bengal and Odisha. It is likely to strengthen further over the next 24 hours and turn into a well-marked low-pressure area.
Due to the influence of this system, rainfall activity is expected to increase in the monsoon core zone – Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, and Rajasthan-in the coming days.
The monsoon trough is currently extending from Amritsar through Muzaffarnagar, Bareilly, Gorakhpur, Patna, and Jamshedpur to the Bay of Bengal.
From June 1 until now, Rajasthan normally receives an average of 364.7 mm of rainfall. This season, the state has received an average of 282.6 mm so far, which is 22% below normal.
What next... The Jaipur Meteorological Centre has forecast dry weather across the state for the next three days. Most parts of the state are likely to remain dry, with sunshine and a slight rise in temperatures expected.
Weather Conditions in Major Cities of Rajasthan
Jaipur remained clear and sunny throughout Sunday. The temperature dipped slightly during the day due to light winds. Jaipur recorded a maximum temperature of 34°C and a minimum of 25.8°C. The weather is expected to remain dry in Jaipur for the next two days.
The weather remained clear throughout the day in Jaipur on Sunday. There was a slight drop in temperature
Kota also received no rain on Sunday. It remained sunny since morning. The maximum temperature dropped slightly on Sunday. The maximum temperature was 33 degrees Celsius, while the minimum was 24.8 degrees Celsius. According to the weather department, Kota is likely to receive rain in the first week of September.
It remained sunny throughout the day in Kota on Sunday. There is a possibility of rain in the first week of September
Jodhpur experienced normal weather on Sunday. The morning was cloudy and windy, keeping the weather cool. The maximum temperature was recorded at 34.4 degrees Celsius, which was 0.1 degrees above normal.
The minimum temperature was recorded at 25.7 degrees Celsius, which was 0.2 degrees above normal. According to the Meteorological Department, there is no rain alert for the next few days.
Clouds gathered and winds blew in Jodhpur in the morning. This made the weather cooler
Alwar residents have been troubled by humidity due to no rain for the past four days. The heat has been making people sweat as early as 8 a.m. in the city. The occasional light, cool breeze does provide people with momentary relief. On Sunday, Alwar recorded a maximum temperature of 34.8°C and a minimum of 26°C.
The humidity made people miserable in Alwar due to the lack of rain
Ajmer district's monsoon has weakened once again. The sun shone brightly from Sunday morning. The heat and humidity caused discomfort. According to the Meteorological Department, the maximum temperature on Sunday was recorded at 31.2 degrees Celsius and the minimum at 22.6 degrees Celsius.
So far this monsoon season, Ajmer district has recorded 419.0 mm of rainfall. The normal rainfall during this period should have been 385 mm. Thus, rainfall was 8% above normal.
Ajmer remained sunny throughout Sunday. The humidity made people uncomfortable
Udaipur experienced changing weather conditions on Sunday. Cool winds blew in the morning, making the weather pleasant. After that, there was sunshine for some time, followed by cloudy skies.
It has not rained in Udaipur for nearly two weeks. The daytime temperature in Udaipur fell by 0.4 degrees Celsius. According to the Meteorological Department, the maximum temperature was 30.5 degrees.
The weather became pleasant in Udaipur due to the cool breeze
Sikar had clear weather throughout the day on Sunday. The heat and humidity troubled people. The minimum temperature recorded here was 23.5 degrees, while the maximum was 37 degrees.
The weather remained clear throughout the day in Sikar. The heat troubled people
